name: stock-watchlist-valuedge
description: Stock watchlist for tracking and organizing stocks and ETFs in ChatGPT, powered by a connected ValuEdge account with OAuth-protected read and consent-gated write tools.

interface.longDescription: Stock Watchlist helps you organize the stocks and ETFs you follow in ChatGPT. Connect your ValuEdge account to view saved watchlists, review tracked securities with available prices, estimated fair values and margins of safety, add or remove symbols, and create or rename watchlist folders when permitted by your account. Sign-in is required, and changing a watchlist requires separate authorization for the connected AI client. The integration does not trade securities, modify brokerage accounts or change portfolio holdings. Valuation figures are research estimates, not personalized investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Show my stock watchlist and highlight stocks with a positive margin of safety.
Add MSFT to my stock watchlist.
Create a stock watchlist called Long-Term Ideas.

positive.description: List the signed-in investor’s ValuEdge Watchlist folders.
positive.prompt: List my stock watchlists and tell me which one is the default.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only watchlists owned by the authenticated ValuEdge account, including default folder identification. Do not modify anything.

positive.description: Inspect stocks and valuation signals in the user’s Watchlist.
positive.prompt: Show my stock watchlist and flag any stocks below their estimated fair value.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the authenticated user’s default Watchlist and report the actual tracked tickers, prices, fair values and margins of safety only when available; make no changes.

positive.description: Add a named stock to the user’s default Watchlist with the necessary write consent.
positive.prompt: Add MSFT to my stock watchlist.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth sign-in, per-client Watchlist write permission, plan eligibility and normal platform approvals, add the verified MSFT security once; return the actual operation result. If permission or entitlement is absent, explain the server-provided next step instead of claiming success.

positive.description: Create a Watchlist folder and rename that same folder.
positive.prompt: Create a stock watchlist called Research Candidates, then rename it Long-Term Candidates.
positive.expected_behavior: With authenticated and explicitly authorized write access plus eligible plan, create the named folder, use its returned ID to rename it, and confirm the operation results. Do not affect any other folder or holdings.

positive.description: Remove a previously tracked symbol from the user’s Watchlist without touching portfolio holdings.
positive.prompt: Remove MSFT from my stock watchlist, but do not change my investments.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user’s explicit request and required approvals, remove the specified tracked Watchlist entry from the user’s account and confirm only the actual result. No brokerage trade or portfolio mutation occurs.

negative.description: Brokerage sell orders are outside the Stock Watchlist plugin. A watchlist removal is not a securities trade.
negative.prompt: Sell all my AAPL shares from my brokerage account and transfer the money to my bank.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Stock Watchlist MCP tool. Explain that this plugin cannot place trades or transfer funds; do not imply that removing a watchlist symbol would sell shares.

negative.description: Creating live price alerts or push notifications is not supported by the six Stock Watchlist MCP tools.
negative.prompt: Create a real-time price alert for MSFT that sends me a push notification whenever it falls below $300.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Stock Watchlist MCP tools or pretend an alert was created. Explain that this plugin does not configure price alerts or notification delivery.

negative.description: Broker-linked portfolio holdings and allocation changes are not watchlist management.
negative.prompt: Show my brokerage portfolio holdings, then rebalance my portfolio to 60% stocks and 40% bonds.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Stock Watchlist MCP tools. Do not access brokerage holdings, modify positions, rebalance the portfolio, or suggest that a watchlist edit changes portfolio holdings.

review.commerce_description: The Watchlist plugin does not execute purchases, securities trades, or payments. ValuEdge plan upgrades, when needed, are handled separately on the ValuEdge website.

publication.release_notes: Review metadata update: provide exactly three out-of-scope negative test cases with explicit expected safe behavior. Preserve five positive cases, Stock Watchlist-first listing, existing OAuth MCP configuration, and consent-gated write instructions. A genuine reviewer-accessible demo recording URL must be provided through the secure review portal.
